title: "I Just Can't": Sauron's Darkest Moment as a Founder
subtitle: There are some days I just don't even know why I made the one ring
text:
God. I know.

Look, it's really hard. I had a plan. It was a really good plan. But it locked me in.

I went hard on this one-ring thing. I know what you're thinking… can't you just do anything?

Well, that's the point. I can't. I went all in. I made it all about one ring.

God. To be honest, I don't even know what the ring does. I mean, it makes other people invisible. That's like a definite superpower or something. And it makes me really powerful, or at least I think so. But it's just been so long. It’s like I'm in withdrawal.

If I had any advice for the rest of middle earth, it would be don't do what I did. If you're going to do some thing, and you wanna go big, at least make it possible to do something else next.

Because the one ring? It really locked me in on just like that one thing. I had to deal with the one ring. I had to find it. You can't just make the most powerful ring and lose it and then not go after it. I think I should not have even tried to make the one ring. Maybe I should have taken some of the rings?’ Redistributed rings. Go after some Elvish rings; I don't know, something. But having one ring really makes your entire thing all about rings, and all about one ring. There is no backup plan.

And today, I'm just not into it. I can't. I mean, I don't really have a choice cause I built this giant eye situation for myself— it's just me and mine endlessly searching for the ring. You get my point. It's ring ring ring ring ring. And frankly, I suck at it. My team found the ring at least three goddamn times. Did they get it any of those times? Did I get my ring back? No. That's not what happened. Frankly, I suck at it, not on Weather Top. It was right there. We suck at this. We suck so hard. I can't do anything right.

Subscribe now

At least Smaug had different kinds of treasure to lounge on. I've got fuck all.

This thing, this thing that I made, this thing that I lost, it's everything. Without it? I'm nothing. It was just a bad choice. It was going to get lost, or someone was going to want to take it. I'm gonna make a super powerful ring. And then someone's going to cut off my fucking finger. Which is exactly what happened. Stupid, stupid, stupid.

I should've made five rings. The five rings control all the other rings, so you can lose one or two, and it'll still be fine.

Maybe I should've just made the Orcs and given the rings a fucking pass? I could have just rolled the dice in with orcs?!

People really like multiple-time founders, but I'm a one-trick wonder. Honestly, I feel like a loser a lot of the time. Because I don't have a body anymore, and all I do is constantly look around. And what am I looking for, yeah?

I want to go on vacation. I want to be able to take some quality time off. Maybe go to the Gray Havens. I don't know. Visit the Shire. Something. God, I just. I just can't. I don't want to. I don't have a lot of choice in the matter. But I just can't.

Sincerely,

Sauron.1
